title: T1-T12 total ROM, step 2 Poly w/o [2] (Liebsch 2020)
subcategory: stepwise rib cage reduction and segment isolation

quantity.name: ROM
quantity.definition: total T1-T12 full-range rotation (both directions) at +/-5 Nm, third cycle; median (max/min) of 8

source.sample: 8 fresh-frozen human C7-L1 thoracic spines with intact rib cage (middle-aged male donors)

protocol.summary: 8 C7-L1 rib cage specimens, pure moments +/-5 Nm FE/LB/AR, 1 deg/s, 3.5 cycles (3rd evaluated), no preload; optical tracking of all vertebrae. Stepwise: [1] poly intact, [2] poly without anterior rib-to-rib/sternal connections, [3] monosegments (T1-T2, T3-T4, ..., T11-T12) with ribs, [4] monosegments without ribs.
how_to_simulate: Steps 1-2: fix L1, load C7 with pure moments +/-5 Nm (FE, LB, AR), 1 deg/s, no preload; model rib cage per ribcage.intact_structures
Steps 3-4: isolated monosegment potted at both ends, same moments
Report total T1-T12 rotation (full range) at peak moment
protocol.notes: Median and range (n=8). pct_of_previous_median = RC column (relative change of median vs previous step) as printed. NZ only shown in Figs 3-5 (not extracted; authors state segmental NZ too variable).

extraction.check_notes: Parsed from text layer by regex and spot-checked against printed tables.

pass_rule.rule: model within [min,max] of specimens (median as target)

ribcage.intact_structures: ribs, costovertebral joints and segmental sternal pieces kept, but sternum and all cartilaginous rib-to-rib connections cut transversally at every intercostal level (no intersegmental anterior connection)

loading.branch: ROM at +/-5 Nm (full range), third cycle
loading.device: custom spine tester, Vicon 12 cameras (<0.1 deg)

sequence: Poly intact [1]: C7-L1 with intact rib cage
Poly w/o [2]: sternum and all cartilaginous rib-to-rib connections cut transversally at each intercostal level
Mono intact [3]: specimen partitioned into monosegments T1-T2, T3-T4, T5-T6, T7-T8, T9-T10, T11-T12, each with its ribs and sternal/costal piece
Mono w/o [4]: ribs removed at the costovertebral joints (monosegment without ribs)
